name: App & Website Experience - Positive
definition: Praise regarding the design, ease of use, speed, or technical performance of the application or website.

name: App & Website Experience - Negative
definition: Complaints regarding bugs, crashes, glitches, slow performance, or poor user interface of the application or website.

name: Customer Service - Positive
definition: Praise for the helpfulness, responsiveness, or professionalism of support staff or agents.

name: Customer Service - Negative
definition: Complaints regarding unresponsive, unhelpful, or rude support staff and customer service channels.

name: Product Quality - Positive
definition: Satisfaction with the quality, fit, material, or variety of physical products purchased.

name: Product Quality - Negative
definition: Dissatisfaction with the quality, condition, sizing, or accuracy of physical products purchased.

name: Delivery & Logistics - Positive
definition: Praise for the speed, timing, or accuracy of shipping and delivery services.

name: Delivery & Logistics - Negative
definition: Complaints regarding delays, lost items, cancellations, or errors in the delivery process.

name: Travel & Hospitality - Positive
definition: Positive experiences with hotels, flights, restaurants, or transportation services booked or found via the service.

name: Travel & Hospitality - Negative
definition: Negative experiences with hotels, flights, restaurants, or transportation services booked or found via the service.

name: Pricing & Value - Positive
definition: Praise for low prices, good deals, discounts, investment returns, or general value for money.

name: Pricing & Value - Negative
definition: Complaints about high costs, hidden fees, poor financial returns, or lack of value.

name: Trust & Security - Positive
definition: Expressions of trust, safety, or reliability regarding the platform or service provider.

name: Trust & Security - Negative
definition: Accusations of scams, fraud, privacy violations, or general untrustworthiness.

name: General Sentiment - Positive
definition: General praise or recommendation of the service without mentioning a specific functional aspect.

name: General Sentiment - Negative
definition: General criticism or disapproval of the service without mentioning a specific functional aspect.
